analysis_mask.description: Pixels classified as winter cereals that are also classified as irrigated. The classification is undefined outside this mask.

et_mm.description: Area-weighted actual evapotranspiration over the analysis mask for one dekad.

rainfall_mm.description: Daily precipitation summed to the same dekad and aggregated over the same analysis mask.

area_ha.description: Irrigated winter-cereal area in the union council.

aggregation.rule: ET and rainfall must describe the same surface and the same dekad dates. Rainfall must not be averaged over the whole union council while ET is averaged only over crops.

precedence: If irrigated winter-cereal area is null or <= 0, return nodata.
If et_mm is null or rainfall_mm is null, return nodata.
If et_mm < 0 or rainfall_mm < 0, return nodata and flag the record as invalid.

rounding.rule: Never reclassify from the rounded display value.

water_deficit.boundary_note: Exactly 30.0 mm is red. This resolves the conflict between the initial rule (red > 30) and the later rule (red >= 30).
water_deficit.clamping: Do not clamp negative deficit to zero. A negative value means rainfall exceeded actual ET and is classified green.

legend.subtitle_en: Irrigated winter cereals · last ten days

items.description_en: Rainfall meets or exceeds actual ET over the irrigated winter-cereal area.
Actual ET exceeds rainfall by more than 0 mm and less than 30 mm.
Actual ET exceeds rainfall by 30 mm or more.
No irrigated winter-cereal area, or ET/rainfall is unavailable for this area and period.

legend.disclaimer_en: Area-level screening signal, not a farm-level measurement, forecast or drought warning.

datasets.name: FAO WaPOR v3 Actual Evapotranspiration
datasets.provider: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations

minimum_mask_area_rule.note: A minimum area or pixel count is needed to flag low-confidence aggregates. No value is fixed yet.
